result.instructions: Tools for Spreadconnect, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is the status of Spreadconnect order 123456 and has it shipped?"; "Which of my Spreadconnect articles have sizes that are out of stock?"; "Show the tracking numbers for order 123456.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Spreadconnect data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run spod_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run spod_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run spod_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. spod_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: spod_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Spreadconnect integration this API key belongs to: merchant id, point-of-sale id, name and type. A cheap way to confirm the connection. GET /authentication.

tools.name: spod_list_articles
tools.title: List articles
tools.description: List the articles (your own designed products) of this point of sale: id, title, description and variants with sku, size, colour and prices. The sku is what spod_create_order needs. GET /articles.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset to get the next page.

tools.name: spod_get_article
tools.title: Get article
tools.description: One article with all details: variants (sku, size, colour, prices), images and configuration. GET /articles/{articleId}.

tools.name: spod_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by Spreadconnect order id: state (NEW, CONFIRMED, PROCESSED, CANCELLED), items with their production state, prices and the shipping address. There is no list-orders endpoint, so the id must be known (from spod_create_order or the Spreadconnect app). GET /orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: spod_get_order_shipments
tools.title: Get order shipments
tools.description: The shipments of an order: carrier, tracking number and link, and which order items each contains. GET /orders/{orderId}/shipments.

tools.name: spod_get_order_shipping_types
tools.title: Get order shipping types
tools.description: The shipping types available for an order, with id, carrier, name and price. Pick one id for spod_set_order_shipping_type. GET /orders/{orderId}/shippingTypes.

tools.name: spod_create_order
tools.title: Create order (unconfirmed)
tools.description: WRITE: create a new order in Spreadconnect from article skus (spod_list_articles) and a delivery address. The order is created UNCONFIRMED (state NEW): nothing is produced or charged until it is confirmed with spod_confirm_order, which needs a shipping type first (spod_get_order_shipping_types, spod_set_order_shipping_type). The customer's email and phone are sent to Spreadconnect and the carrier. Prices are what the customer paid (for the invoice/customs), not what you pay Spreadconnect. Calling it twice creates two orders. POST /orders.

external_order_name.description: Optional display name for the order.

phone.description: Customer phone number (required by the API).

amount.description: Amount including VAT / sales tax, zero or more.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR or USD.

customer_price.description: What the customer paid for this line (quantity included).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE or US.

state.description: 2-letter state code; required for the USA and Canada (e.g. CA, NY).

zipCode.description: Postal code; may be an empty string for countries without one.

amount.description: Amount including VAT / sales tax, zero or more.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR or USD.

shipping_customer_price.description: What the customer paid for shipping.

preferred_shipping_type.description: Preferred shipping speed (default decided by Spreadconnect).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE or US.

state.description: 2-letter state code; required for the USA and Canada (e.g. CA, NY).

zipCode.description: Postal code; may be an empty string for countries without one.

tools.name: spod_set_order_shipping_type
tools.title: Set order shipping type
tools.description: WRITE: choose the shipping type of an order that is not confirmed yet (ids from spod_get_order_shipping_types). Required before spod_confirm_order. Setting it again replaces the choice. POST /orders/{orderId}/shippingType.

tools.name: spod_confirm_order
tools.title: Confirm order (sends it to production)
tools.description: WRITE, SPENDS MONEY: confirm an order so Spreadconnect prints and ships it and bills your account for production and shipping. A shipping type must be set first (spod_set_order_shipping_type). After production starts it cannot be undone; before that spod_cancel_order may still work. Only call it when the user clearly asked to place the order. POST /orders/{orderId}/confirm.

tools.name: spod_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel order
tools.description: WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE: cancel an order. Spreadconnect refuses it once items are in production or sent. A cancelled order cannot be reopened. POST /orders/{orderId}/cancel.

tools.name: spod_list_product_types
tools.title: List product types
tools.description: The Spreadconnect catalog of blank products you can put designs on (t-shirts, hoodies, mugs...): id, name, brand, sizes, colours (appearances), print type, views and print areas. The ids are used to create articles. The reply is large. GET /productTypes.

limit.description: Return only the first N product types (default 50) to keep the reply small.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset to get the next page.

tools.name: spod_get_product_type
tools.title: Get product type
tools.description: One catalog product type with all details: sizes, colours, print areas, views, print type and descriptions. GET /productTypes/{productTypeId}.

tools.name: spod_list_product_categories
tools.title: List product categories
tools.description: The catalog category tree plus the available features, brands and genders. GET /productTypes/categories.

tools.name: spod_list_stock
tools.title: List stock
tools.description: Available stock for the variants of this point of sale as a map of sku to stock amount, paged. GET /stock.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset to get the next page.

tools.name: spod_get_stock_by_sku
tools.title: Get stock for a sku
tools.description: Available stock of one variant by its sku. GET /stock/{sku}.

tools.name: spod_get_stock_by_product_type
tools.title: Get stock for a product type
tools.description: Available stock of every size and colour of one catalog product type. GET /stock/productType/{productTypeId}.

annotations.title: Get stock for a product type

tools.name: spod_upload_design
tools.title: Upload design from URL
tools.description: WRITE: have Spreadconnect download an image from a public URL and store it as a reusable design; returns a designId for spod_create_article. Uploading the same URL again stores another copy. POST /designs/upload.

url.description: Public https URL of the design image (PNG, under 10 MB).

tools.name: spod_create_article
tools.title: Create article
tools.description: WRITE: create an article (a sellable product) from a catalog product type, chosen colours and sizes, and one or more designs placed on views. Get the ids from spod_get_product_type and use designId from spod_upload_design or a public PNG url. Spreadconnect makes the article available in the connected shop integration. Calling it twice creates two articles. Returns the new article id. POST /articles.

appearance_id.description: Colour id from the product type's appearances.

size_id.description: Size id from the product type's sizes.

url.description: Public https URL of a PNG under 10 MB.

designId.description: Id returned by spod_upload_design; wins over url when both are given.

hotspot.description: Named print position on the view.

print_type.description: DD (default) or DTF; DTF only for accounts activated for it.

tools.name: spod_delete_article
tools.title: Delete article
tools.description: WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE: permanently delete an article from this point of sale. It cannot be restored; existing orders are not affected. DELETE /articles/{articleId}.
